candidate_subsets.description: Inhibitory ring-neuron to compass-neuron synapses in the ellipsoid body, restricted to the two visually driven ring-neuron families that receive TuBu input.
candidate_subsets.sign_in_prepared_graph: all negative (every ER neuron is predicted GABAergic: 282/282)
candidate_subsets.allowed_update: depression only (|w| decreases toward 0); sign flip forbidden

candidate_subsets.description: All ring-neuron to compass-neuron synapses (26 ER types). Wider superset; includes sleep/nutritional/non-visual ER families.

Kenyon cell to mushroom-body output neuron synapses, the best-sourced plastic site in the fly; not recommended as the FIRST target because neither the odour encoder nor an MBON-to-motor decoder is verified in this build.
candidate_subsets.allowed_update: bidirectional within [0.1, 2.0] x initial; sign flip forbidden

candidate_subsets.description: Single-compartment version of the olfactory subset: KC inputs to MBON01 (gamma1pedc>alpha/beta), the compartment innervated by PPL101.

WP5's verified loop. Best-verified IO map, but no primary source for experience-dependent plasticity at these synapses, and the HS/H2 -> DNa02 bottleneck is 8 edges, so a rule there is a gain knob, not a learning model.

EL.note: accounts for 4488 of the 4514 octopaminergic edges onto ER neurons in this graph
EL.source: Plitt 2025 (preprint): octopamine from EL neurons instructs depression of ER->EPG synapses

ExR2.source: Fisher 2022: dopamine (PPM3/ExR2) is a when-to-learn signal scaling with rotational speed

known_engine_confound.modulator_edges_are_excitatory: dopamine, octopamine, serotonin and 'unclear' neurons are all mapped to POSITIVE weights in the prepared graph, so DAN/OAN spikes currently act as fast ionotropic excitation in the LIF proxy as well as being read as a modulatory signal by any WP6 rule. This double-counting must be declared in the run manifest.

blocking_dependency: brainlab/engine.py LIF fix (runaway ~1e6 spikes/s self-sustained state and non-responsive right side, WP5 section 6). A conductance-based dynamics v2 (engine.advance_v2, docs/LIF_DYNAMICS_SPEC.md) landed while this spec was written; default is still v1. WP6 should be run under v2, the dynamics_version belongs in the prereg and manifest, and no confirmatory WP6 run should start before WP5's optomotor set has been re-run under v2 and shows a quiet baseline and bilateral responsiveness.
